interface.shortDescription: Visible ChatGPT control plus durable autonomous repository development
interface.longDescription: ChatGPT Surface Control lets Codex agents operate the visible ChatGPT Chat and Work experiences and run durable repository-development workflows. It supports exact Project-scoped planner and worker conversations, autonomous task DAGs, local Codex implementation, independent testing, exact-SHA worker and planner review gates, explicit recovery, surface detection, verified configuration, progress polling, steering, files, artifacts, downloads, Markdown capture, redacted reports, and structured blockers. It does not bypass ChatGPT login, call hidden endpoints, read cookies, or replace the OpenAI API or official Codex SDK.
